rag.tooltip: Retrieval-Augmented Generation searches through uploaded quotation PDFs to extract exact evidence passages without generating unverified assumptions.

vector.tooltip: Indexes document text semantically so search finds relevant clauses even when exact wording differs.

chunk.tooltip: A specific paragraph or table passage extracted directly from an uploaded vendor document.

deterministic.tooltip: Calculates composite decision scores using fixed, auditable formulas rather than non-deterministic AI outputs.

compositeScore.tooltip: Weighted aggregate score (0 to 100) combining Landed Cost, Delivery Time, Risk Index, Quality, and Compliance.
